text:
maria: Hey support, multiple customers report that when they set Region=EU and Model=redwood-llama-2 with Version=v2024-07 the dashboard shows US traffic counts. Happens across orgs. Anyone else?
dan: seeing same on my repro org. If I toggle region off/on counts jump. :eyes:
maria: Account examples: org-312 (tenant id abcd). Happened ~2026-03-01 09:12 UTC. I can share screenshots.
support-bot: Thanks for reporting — can you confirm steps to reproduce and which dashboard/timeframe? Also, please include request-id if you have API traces.
maria: Steps:
1) Go to Analytics > Model usage
2) Set Region: EU
3) Model: redwood-llama-2
4) Version: v2024-07
5) Time: last 24h
6) Observe counts show US buckets in model breakdown.
dan: quick repro: if you select EU + multiple versions it seems to ignore version filter and shows aggregated across regions. Single-version selection works sometimes.
sophie: tagging eng-analytics @leo @eng-analytics-bot — possible regression after recent filter-normalization PR?
leo: I can reproduce. Looks like the query param normalization is collapsing "region" when version is multi-select. Investigating.
leo: console query shows: ?region=eu&model=redwood-llama-2&version=v2024-07,v2024-08 -> backend receives version=[v2024-07,v2024-08] but region becomes region=null
leo: suspicion: bucket key normalization step uses commas to encode version list and overwrites region key. I'll run local unit tests.
maria: attaching screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/xyz.png
dan: also customers reported a related burndown: latency spikes when toggling filters. Might be re-requesting global aggregation.
leo: created issue #INF-4421 with repro and started a hotfix branch. ETA for PR: 3 hours.
eng-analytics-bot: INF-4421 created by leo. Labels: bug, high-priority, dashboards.
sophie: thanks. Can support message customers with workaround?
maria: Workaround: select single version OR remove model version filter and use model alias + filter by region in the column breakdown. Not ideal but temporary.
dan: adding logs: frontend console shows fetch to /analytics/query with body:
```
{
  "filters": { "region": ["eu"], "model": ["redwood-llama-2"], "version": ["v2024-07","v2024-08"] }
}
```
and server logs show normalized filters: {"model":"redwood-llama-2","version":"v2024-07,v2024-08"} 
leo: thanks, PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/inf/PR/5678 — fixes comma escape in normalization. Rolling to staging now.
maria: :thumbsup: can you add regression test?
leo: adding test, will include e2e in staging. I'll post update when staged.
support-bot: Noted. I'll DM affected customers with workaround and share incident link when fix is deployed.
maria: great — keep us posted.
(End)
